cascade: main.tsx import order: theme.css -> lovable-globals.css -> styles.css
lovable-globals.css: @theme inline (maps --color-* to :root Lovable vars) + :root oklch SOT
Tailwind v4: later @theme/@theme inline merges; lovable @theme inline should override matching --color-* keys from theme.css
BUT theme.css-only tokens (--color-trust, --elevation-*, --glass-*, rocket-*, auth-*) remain from theme.css unless redefined in lovable
styles.css helpers reference theme.css PHONARA names (--color-trust, --elevation-sheet, --color-bg) not Lovable :root names
